model_cannot_express: attribute namespaces and prefixes of foreign attributes (xlink:href, xml:lang, xmlns:xlink): compared by lexical lowercase name only

the markup reading of noscript under scripting: the crate parses the content as markup, a scripting browser reads raw text; compared as the source slice with scripting=true and as a tree with scripting=false
